item.title: Netherlands women’s rugby in form as Fijiana prepare for tough test tomorrow
item.description: The Netherlands women's rugby team is in good form at the moment, and the Vodafone Fijiana XVs will need to be on top of their game plan to counter them tomorrow. Speaking during a press conference in Hong Kong, Head Coach Willie Walker says the Fijiana will need to defend well and carry the ball effectively in attack if they are to secure a victory tomorrow.
item.content:encoded:
The Netherlands women's rugby team is in good form at the moment, and the Vodafone Fijiana XVs will need to be on top of their game plan to counter them tomorrow.

Speaking during a press conference in Hong Kong, Head Coach Willie Walker says the Fijiana will need to defend well and carry the ball effectively in attack if they are to secure a victory tomorrow.

Walker says he has confidence in his players and the game plan they have put in place to counter the Netherlands team.

He says his players are working hard for each other, and if they can hold on to the ball and build pressure against a very physical and well-conditioned side, they will give themselves a chance of securing the win.

Walker says they will have to work hard to earn the victory.

The Fijiana XVs will face Netherlands at 4pm tomorrow.

item.title: Navatu Secondary School’s rugby dream realised with $8,000 gym equipment boost
item.description: The Navatu Secondary School rugby dream of owning a proper gym has become a reality after their Under-19 rugby team Captain made a plea for assistance to help the school better prepare for the Vodafone Super Deans. Minister of Sports Jese Saukuru responded to their plea and handed over $8000 worth of gym and sporting equipment to the school.
item.content:encoded:
The Navatu Secondary School rugby dream of owning a proper gym has become a reality after their Under-19 rugby team Captain made a plea for assistance to help the school better prepare for the Vodafone Super Deans.

Minister of Sports Jese Saukuru responded to their plea and handed over $8000 worth of gym and sporting equipment to the school.

Saukuru says when he heard the interview with Navatu Secondary School Under-19 captain Vilimone Kanawabu following their historic Super Deans final, one thing stood out to him was that these young men had the talent, determination and heart, but they did not have a proper training ground or gym to support their development.

Saukuru says to the young people of Navatu and the North that their talent should never be limited by where you come from and their dreams are just as important, and that their hard work deserves to be supported.

item.title: Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury to meet in long-awaited all-British heavyweight clash in December
item.description: Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury will contest their long-awaited all-British heavyweight fight at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on 11th December. The bout, more than a decade in the making, will be broadcast globally on Netflix.
item.content:encoded:
Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury will contest their long-awaited all-British heavyweight fight at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on 11th December.

The bout, more than a decade in the making, will be broadcast globally on Netflix.

Organisers are considering a late start to cater for audiences in the United States.

Joshua and Fury will come face-to-face at a news conference in London on Wednesday, 30th September, as the build-up begins to one of the most anticipated fights in British boxing history.

Joshua says he is inspiring a generation while Fury is yet to comment on the announcement.

The event is being promoted as a collaboration between Saudi boxing powerbroker Turki Alalshikh's The Ring and UFC chief Dana White.

Alalshikh says t wo of the best heavyweights of this generation, finally in the ring together.

The former two-time world champions had already signed contracts for the bout earlier this year, but the date and venue had yet to be confirmed.

London's Wembley Stadium and New York's Madison Square Garden were the frontrunners to stage the fight, but both presented logistical issues before Cardiff recently emerged as an alternative.

The Principality Stadium has hosted late-night boxing before, including Joe Calzaghe's fight against Mikkel Kessler in November 2007.

Welsh Rugby Union and Cardiff Council officials welcomed the fight, saying it would reinforce the city's reputation for staging major events and could provide a significant economic boost, although some operational details still need to be finalised.

Joshua had been pushing for the fight to take place in the UK and has got his wish.

On 11th December, two of the biggest heavyweights of this generation finally collide and the winner will take a significant place in heavyweight history.

item.title: Fijiana need to be more clinical against formidable Netherlands – Walker
item.description: The Vodafone Fijiana will look to capitalise on the opportunities they create and be more clinical in their finishing when they face a formidable Netherlands side tomorrow. Speaking during a press conference from Hong Kong, Head Coach Willie Walker says one of the team’s strengths is their ability to create opportunities, beat defenders and make line breaks.
item.content:encoded:
The Vodafone Fijiana will look to capitalise on the opportunities they create and be more clinical in their finishing when they face a formidable Netherlands side tomorrow.

Speaking during a press conference from Hong Kong, Head Coach Willie Walker says one of the team’s strengths is their ability to create opportunities, beat defenders and make line breaks.

Walker says they need to be more clinical in finishing the chances they create so the scoreboard better reflects their dominance in possession and their ability to hold on to the ball.

The former Auckland Blues player says areas of concern and emphasis will also be around the ruck and maul, as the Netherlands have a very strong pack and the Fijiana players will need to be tough around the fringes.

Insert Coach Willie on work-ons 25th Sep

The Fijiana will face the Netherlands tomorrow at 4pm in Hong Kong.
